featured_reviews.name: Pranav Dasgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review with extreme disappointment regarding my recent experiences at Naaz Aquarium, Kurla. This shop was once a reliable source for aquarium hobbyists, but the quality of products and customer service has severely declined.
My primary concern is the repeated sale of faulty equipment and the lack of accountability, particularly from a staff member named Parvez Bhai.

Incident 1: Faulty Heater & Extra Cost
My first bad experience involved the purchase of an RS brand heater. I was overcharged for the item (sold for 200 \text{ Rs} when marked at 150 \text{ Rs}) and, worse, the heater was completely non-functional upon testing it at home.
I had to spend over 500 \text{ Rs} in petrol just to drive back to the store and exchange a brand-new, faulty item. This was a massive waste of time and money due to the store’s lack of quality control.

❌ Incident 2: The Same Mistake Twice
Thinking the first instance was a one-off, I returned again around Diwali to purchase a 100 \text{ Watt RS brand heater} for my neighbor, who is new to the hobby. I explicitly explained my previous bad experience to the staff before making the purchase.
Shockingly, the 100 \text{ Watt} heater was also FAULTY.

Verdict on Quality Control
Selling two faulty RS brand heaters in a row, especially after being warned about the previous issue, shows a severe lack of quality control and zero respect for the customer's time and money. It makes me question if the issue is with the RS brand itself, or if Naaz Aquarium is selling old, untested, or defective stock.

This shop needs to seriously re-evaluate its product inspection process and customer service. I highly suggest other buyers proceed with caution, especially when purchasing equipment, as you may end up spending more on returns than on the product itself.

featured_reviews.name: Tiven Gonsalves (Tiven2240)
featured_reviews.review_text: Trombay fish market is one of the oldest market in Mumbai. It has a variety of fish available for Sale in it's market. The variety of prawns and other fishes too were found here. Trombay fish market has a connectivity of Bus which has the direct accessibility to this place. The birhanmumbai municipal corporation and the birhanmumbai electrical supply and transport along with the forest department and Indian Navy have a strong hold over this place. The place is well maintained by local villagers who have made a concrete platform for them to sell fish in very large quantity. The market starts from 7.30-8.00 am in the morning and gets wind up at around 10 in the morning. After that the local fishing community have their trade of fishing at the market which has been developed for them on the coast of the Village. The villagers are very cooperative and have a fragile nature. They are very good to interact with others and provide personalised experience to the other people's who visit this place.
